spanish: Y la fila la cuarta: tarsis, ónice y jaspe; rodeadas de engastes de oro en sus engastes.
grammarChanges: Replaced the untranslated transliteration shóham (H7718, masculine singular absolute common noun) with the common noun ónice.
Replaced the untranslated transliteration yashfé (H3471, masculine singular absolute common noun) with the common noun jaspe.
Replaced llenuras (abstract fullness) with engastes to match H4396 as the concrete noun of settings/fillings; en sus already carries the preposition and the 3mp suffix.

Kept rodeadas de unchanged: Spanish requires the preposition to link the passive participle to its complement, even though the Hebrew hophal participle and מִשְׁבְּצוֹת are juxtaposed with no preposition.
readerNote: Kept 'de' in 'rodeadas de engastes' because Spanish grammar requires a preposition linking the passive participle to its complement, unlike the Hebrew juxtaposition flagged by the auditor.
